meta.notes: What NICEHCK's web app (app.nicehck.cn, protocol variant "ttgk_v1") allows on every device it drives: peaking bands only, 20 to 20000 Hz, Q 0.2 to 12 (sent as 51/256, the grid point below 0.2), gain ±12 dB, pre-gain -12 to +8 dB in whole dB. The app writes the pre-gain into each band frame (byte 34) and in the 0x03 command as s16 ×256, and ends a write with [1,0x0A,4,0,0,FF,FF], [1,0x01], the pre-gain and [1,0x04], where the handler sends devicePEQ's commit; whether both persist the same is unconfirmed. The app tags each write with the index of the preset it came from: its official presets from 1, its own custom presets from 32. Game, sleep and diffuse modes are official presets written like any other, not a device command. The app has no EQ off switch, and the [1,1,0,…] the handler used to send for one left the PureAural's EQ on. It follows a mic gain write with [1,0x04], which Walkplay's own app doesn't send (micGainDone).
